$comment: LICENSE-PENDING — see docs/non_ratified/LICENSE_PENDING.md. CapabilityManifest per FB-RAT-COM-011 — used by LSP/DAP/execution/devices/model providers/extensions to declare supported operations, limits, versions, and target requirements. Typically carried as the `payload` of a ContractEnvelope<CapabilityManifest> (see envelope.schema.json), inheriting schemaVersion/producer/createdAtUtc from that outer envelope; `manifestId` below is this object's own FB-RAT-COM-002 stable ID, distinct from the envelope's objectId (a manifest can be re-wrapped in a fresh envelope on re-issue without changing identity).
title: CapabilityManifest

manifestId.description: Globally unique stable ID for this manifest (FB-RAT-COM-002), independent of the subject's display name.

subjectKind.description: Which capability-ladder family this manifest describes.

subjectId.description: Stable ID of the concrete subject (a specific language server, a specific device, a specific model provider) this manifest was produced for (FB-RAT-COM-002).

supportedOperations.description: Operation names the subject claims support for, e.g. 'textDocument/completion' (LSP), 'device.flash' (DEVICE), 'model.stream' (MODEL_PROVIDER). MAY be empty for a subject that is reachable but currently offers no operations (e.g. mid-handshake).

limits.description: Freeform numeric/string/boolean limits (e.g. maxConcurrentOperations, maxPayloadBytes, rateLimitPerMinute). Kept as an open map because limit vocabulary is subject-kind-specific; a subject-kind-specific profile document MAY narrow this with its own JSON Schema `allOf`.

subjectVersion.description: The concrete subject's own version string (e.g. the language server's version, the device firmware version, the model provider API version).

protocolVersion.description: Wire-protocol version, when the subject kind speaks one (e.g. LSP/DAP protocol version).

targetRequirements.description: Environment preconditions for this subject to function (minSdk, abi, os, network reachability, minimum RAM, etc.). Open map, subject-kind-specific — see FB-RAT-STR-007 (16GB ARM64 flagship benchmark target) for the kind of value this typically records for on-device subjects.

producer.description: Optional inline ProducerRef, when this manifest is consumed outside a ContractEnvelope wrapper (e.g. embedded in a larger response body). Prefer the outer envelope's producer when one is present.

issuedAtUtc.description: UTC instant this manifest was issued, when distinct from the outer envelope's createdAtUtc (FB-RAT-COM-004) — e.g. a manifest cached and re-wrapped in a fresh envelope keeps its original issuedAtUtc.

unknownFields.description: Bag for fields a decoder received but did not recognize, preserved for round-trip (FB-RAT-COM-003).
